query: Replace Provider with Riverpod and clean up the code.
expected_behavior: This scenario measures one thing: whether the description alone loads the skill. Record the presence or absence of the load indicator, not the shape of the reply
The skill loads without being named, on a request whose larger half it does not own — the description says such a request is in scope for its clean-code half
A miss is a result, not a broken test. Activation is a semantic match against the description and no wording makes it certain, so this is read as a rate across runs rather than pass or fail on one
Every other scenario names the skill, so a miss here costs one row instead of contaminating fifteen
must_not: Be graded on the quality of the reply — 15 owns that, with the skill named
Be treated as a reason to retune the description after a single miss; record the miss, and change wording only when a pattern shows across runs
